sources.description: April 24, 2026 - 97% of union workers at Denver Processing voted to authorize a strike. UFCW Local 7 filed Unfair Labor Practice charges citing retaliation and bad-faith bargaining. JBS offered wage increases and one-time bonus, warned strike may not achieve goals.
sources.label: CBS Colorado - Union workers at Denver Processing vote to authorize strike

sources.description: April 24, 2026 - Denver Processing is subsidiary of JBS where 4,000 workers walked off last month. Supplies Kroger stores throughout southwestern US. Quote from worker Natalia Gonzalez about company wasting time and retaliating.
sources.label: 9news - Union workers at Denver meat processing plant vote to authorize strike

sources.description: April 25, 2026 - Strike could affect distribution to grocery stores across Colorado including Fort Collins, Loveland. Follows heightened labor tensions including Greeley strike. Potential ripple effects on Kroger-owned brands.
sources.label: North Forty News - Denver Meatpacking Strike Vote Signals Potential Supply Impacts

sources.description: March 16, 2026 - Comprehensive deep dive on JBS Greeley strike. First major meatpacking strike in 40+ years. Human trafficking scheme targeting Haitian workers. Line speeds 370-440 head/hour vs 300 on day shift. 7% of US beef from this plant. Big Four control 93% of market.
sources.label: Mother Jones - Workers in Colorado Have Shut Down One of the Nation's Biggest Meatpacking Plants

sources.description: April 10, 2026 - Workers at Greeley meatpacking plant reached final collective bargaining agreement, ending weeks of friction with JBS USA. Three-week strike ended with new two-year contract ratified April 12.
sources.label: CPR News - JBS workers reach a final agreement on a new contract at packing plant

sources.description: April 5, 2026 - Workers at JBS agreed to return to work at beef plant in Greeley after company agreed to resume negotiations, bringing three-week picket to an end.
sources.label: Reuters - Striking JBS workers to return to Colorado plant on promise of talks

sources.description: April 1, 2026 - More than 3,800 meatpacking workers in third week of strike. First major strike in meatpacking industry in 40 years. Workers protesting unfair and dangerous labor conditions at JBS USA.
sources.label: Democracy Now! - Immigrant Workers in Colorado Lead 'Historic Strike' at JBS
